quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #10
										  					
  

40 Questions • Passing Score 35

questions.question: What should you do at an intersection with a flashing yellow light?

options.text: Wait for the green light before going.
Slow down and cross carefully.
Stop before crossing.

questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down and be careful. Watch for other cars and people before you cross.

questions.question: When you pass parked cars, you should:

options.text: Be ready for a person or car to suddenly enter your lane.
Expect all other drivers and pedestrians to see you.
Drive very close to parked cars to leave room for moving traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready for a person or car to suddenly enter your lane.
questions.explanation: A person may step out of a parked car without looking. A driver may pull out into traffic without seeing you. Keep space between your car and parked cars.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No U-turn.
No turning.
No left turn.

questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around to go the opposite direction at this location.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Do not enter.
No parking.
No U-turn.

questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. You cannot turn around to go the opposite direction at this location.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Watch for pedestrians crossing.
No passing zone.
Work zone ahead.

questions.explanation: This orange warning sign tells you that roadwork is coming up. Stay alert for temporary traffic signs and equipment in work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Do not enter.
Stop ahead.
Construction or roadwork is happening.

questions.explanation: Orange diamond-shaped signs mark construction, maintenance, and utility work. These signs help keep drivers and pedestrians safe in these areas. Traffic fines may be doubled in marked work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No right turn.
You must turn right.
Be careful of traffic on your right.

questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns. You cannot turn right at an intersection where this sign is posted.

questions.question: Traffic is merging into your freeway lane. What should you do?

options.text: Make room for the merging traffic if you can.
Speed up to protect your right-of-way.
Always stay in your position.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make room for the merging traffic if you can.
questions.explanation: When it is safe, make room for vehicles to merge into your lane.

questions.question: If you park in an unusual location, you should:

options.text: Turn on your reverse lights.
Make sure your car is visible from all directions.
Park five feet from the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make sure your car is visible from all directions.
questions.explanation: You are responsible for making your parked car safe for other drivers. Wherever you park, make sure drivers approaching from any direction can see your car.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: One lane ahead.
Merging traffic ahead.
Lane ends ahead.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic may merge into your lane ahead.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you should stop and:

options.text: Check for vehicles only in the direction you plan to go, then proceed.
Let all vehicles go first, whether they arrived before or after you.
Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, you must come to a full stop and check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Do not drink and drive.
The road is slippery when wet.
The road curves ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions immediately ahead. This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet.

questions.question: What is the proper way to enter an expressway from the entrance ramp?

options.text: Go down the ramp and move to your desired lane as soon as possible.
Use the acceleration lane to match traffic speed and merge safely.
Go to the bottom of the ramp, stop completely, then enter the expressway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use the acceleration lane to match traffic speed and merge safely.
questions.explanation: Use the acceleration lane that runs alongside the main road. Adjust your speed in this lane to match expressway traffic before merging when it is safe.

questions.question: You should not start across an intersection if you will block it when the light turns red:

options.text: Under any circumstances.
Unless you entered on a yellow light.
Unless you entered on a green light.

questions.explanation: Even if the light is green, do not enter an intersection unless you can completely cross before the light turns red. Blocking the intersection can result in a citation.

questions.question: When weather or light conditions require you to have your lights on while driving:

options.text: Use your parking lights.
Use your high beams.
Use your low beams.

questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights in fog, snow, or rain. High beam light reflects back and creates glare, making it harder to see.

questions.question: At a railroad crossing, you must:

options.text: Watch for vehicles that must stop at railroad crossings, like school buses and trucks carrying hazardous materials.
Watch for trains coming from multiple directions.
Both of the above.

questions.explanation: Approach all railroad crossings with extreme caution. Cross only when you are sure no train is coming from either direction. Be aware of vehicles that must stop at all railroad crossings, such as school buses and trucks carrying hazardous materials.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.
No left turn.
Merge.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign means traffic is merging from the right. Be ready to allow traffic to merge safely.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop if vehicles are approaching.
Come to a full stop, then proceed when it is safe.
Proceed through the intersection carefully without always stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop, then proceed when it is safe.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop at the marked stop line. Proceed only when it is safe. If there is no stop line, stop before the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop at a point where you can see oncoming traffic.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Do not enter.
Yield the right-of-way.
Parking reserved for people with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign is posted on one-way streets and roads where you cannot enter. You may see it if you try to enter an expressway ramp in the wrong direction.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Intersection ahead.
Merging traffic.
Steep hill ahead.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to upcoming conditions. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Adjust your speed to avoid collisions and brake damage.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Steep grade ahead.
The road ahead has curves and turns.
Slippery when wet.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns drivers that the road is slippery when wet. You should drive carefully in these conditions.

questions.question: A police officer tells you to drive through a red traffic light. What should you do?

options.text: Stop until the light turns green.
Go through the intersection without stopping.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Go through the intersection without stopping.
questions.explanation: Always follow a police officer's directions. A police officer directing traffic overrides traffic signals and signs.

questions.question: When should you be most careful turning or stopping in rainy weather?

options.text: After it has been raining all day.
One half hour after it stops raining.
During the first half hour of rain.

questions.correctAnswerText: During the first half hour of rain.
questions.explanation: Be extra careful during the first half hour of rain. Oil from cars mixes with the rain, making the road very slippery.

questions.question: What should you do if there is a deep puddle on the road ahead?

options.text: Keep your speed to drive through the water quickly.
Avoid the puddle if possible.
Shift into neutral while driving through the water.

questions.explanation: Avoid slippery areas such as puddles, ice, wet leaves, and oil. Dry, solid surfaces are safest for driving.

questions.question: Which statement is correct?

options.text: Use your left foot to brake.
Use your right foot for both braking and accelerating.
Always brake hard to stop quickly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use your right foot for both braking and accelerating.
questions.explanation: Use your right foot for both braking and accelerating. Apply the brakes gently with increasing pressure so your vehicle stops smoothly.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Traffic will be merging into your lane from the right.
Always stop.
Divided highway ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic will be merging into your lane from the right.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that traffic will merge from the right. Be ready to allow merging traffic to safely enter your lane.

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?

options.text: The distance from the road to a bridge or overpass.
The maximum legal height of a vehicle in this state.
The maximum width of a vehicle allowed on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The distance from the road to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This low clearance warning sign shows how much space there is between the road and the bottom of a bridge or overpass.

questions.question: You are merging onto an interstate highway. What should you do?

options.text: Find a safe gap and merge into traffic.
Merge across two lanes at once.
Always stop before entering the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Find a safe gap and merge into traffic.
questions.explanation: Find a large enough gap in traffic to merge safely. Do not stop on the entrance ramp unless there is no safe gap to enter the highway.

questions.question: You see this railroad crossing sign without signal lights. What should you do?

options.text: Come to a complete stop.
Keep a steady speed while looking and listening for trains.
Slow down, look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: At an unmarked railroad crossing, slow down and look both ways. Listen for trains and be ready to stop if you see or hear one coming. Never try to outrun a train.

questions.question: A large truck ahead of you is turning right onto a street with two lanes in each direction. What may happen?

options.text: The truck can complete its turn in either of the two lanes.
The truck may have to swing wide to complete the turn.
The truck must stay in the right lane while turning.

questions.correctAnswerText: The truck may have to swing wide to complete the turn.
questions.explanation: Long vehicles need more space to turn. The rear wheels follow a shorter path than the front wheels. Long trucks often must swing wide to complete a right turn safely.

questions.question: When driving on snow or ice:

options.text: It is safe to use cruise control.
Change your speed and direction slowly and gradually.
Drive the same way you do in normal conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change your speed and direction slowly and gradually.
questions.explanation: On snow or ice, make all speed and direction changes slowly. Never use cruise control on snow or ice. Your tires may slip and you could lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
A pedestrian crossing is ahead.
Pedestrians cannot cross here.

questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers to dangers ahead. This sign warns that pedestrians may be crossing. You must stop and wait if a pedestrian is in the crosswalk.

questions.question: To avoid losing traction on wet roads, you should:

options.text: Make sharp turns.
Brake hard.
Slow down.

questions.explanation: Drive slower on wet roads to prevent your tires from slipping. Keep your tires in good condition. If you lose control, remove your foot from the gas, do not brake, stay in your lane, and let the vehicle slow down naturally.

questions.question: When you see this road sign, you should:

options.text: Keep right.
Keep left.
Pass with caution.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign shows that a divided highway is starting. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: No right turn.
Stop sign ahead.
Divided highway.

questions.explanation: This sign prohibits turning in the direction shown by the arrow. In this case, you cannot turn right.

questions.question: You have a minor crash at an intersection with no injuries and little damage. You should:

options.text: Leave your vehicle in the traffic lane until police arrive.
Move your vehicle out of the traffic lane if you can do so safely.
Do not move your vehicle at all.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move your vehicle out of the traffic lane if you can do so safely.
questions.explanation: After a crash with no injuries, move your vehicle out of traffic if it is safe to do so.

questions.question: Driving at night is more dangerous than driving during the day because:

options.text: You cannot see as far ahead.
The road is always more slippery at night.
Your reaction time is slower at night.

questions.correctAnswerText: You cannot see as far ahead.
questions.explanation: At night, you cannot see as far ahead. Oncoming headlights can also create glare. Always use headlights and drive carefully in the dark.

questions.question: As a vehicle's speed increases:

options.text: Stopping distance decreases.
Speed does not affect stopping distance or crash severity.
Stopping distance and crash severity increase.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stopping distance and crash severity increase.
questions.explanation: Higher speeds increase both stopping distance and the severity of crashes. Serious injury and death are more likely at high speeds. Increase your distance from the car ahead as you drive faster.

questions.question: When driving behind another vehicle at night, you should:

options.text: Use low beam headlights.
Use high beam headlights until you are within 10 feet of the vehicle ahead.
Use high beam headlights.

questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights when following another vehicle at night. Use high beam headlights only in rural areas when no other cars are nearby.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must turn right.
No right turns allowed.
You can turn right on a red light.

questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this intersection. Turning right here is illegal.
